result.note: Tests the official FY26 defence export figure and the public versus private split, the durable data points in this release.

questions.prompt: In April 2026, India reported an all-time high in its defence exports for FY 2025-26. What was the value of these exports?
questions.explain: Defence exports reached INR 38,424 crore (USD 4.6 billion) in FY26, a 62.66% year-on-year jump. The story credits global volatility, in Ukraine and the Caucasus, and the Atmanirbhar Bharat push for the rise.
questions.source: India’s defence exports hit an all-time high of INR 38,424 crore (USD 4.6 billion) in FY26, marking a 62.66% year-on-year jump.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about India's defence exports in FY 2025-26:
items: Exports by government-owned firms grew by about 151%, giving them more than half of the total.
Exports by private firms grew at a faster rate than those of government-owned firms.
The number of active defence exporters grew to 145.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 2 is wrong. Private firms grew 14%, far below the 151% leap by government-owned firms, which took a 54.84% share. India now ships defence hardware to more than 80 nations.
questions.source: Government-owned firms led the way, with exports leaping 151% to claim a 54.84% market share.
